blocks.text: Gravity se khaali space mein koi force kisi ko spacecraft ki kisi deewar ki taraf nahi dhakelti. Agar spacecraft ko lambe arse tak orbit mein rehna ho to weightlessness (wazan mehsoos na hona) astronauts ke kaam par bura asar daal sakti hai. Iska hal: spacecraft mein artificial gravity paida ki jaye, taake crew taqreeban normal tareeqe se kaam kar sake. Iske liye spaceship ko apne axis ke gird ghumaya jata hai. Astronaut outer kinare (rim) ki taraf dabta hai aur spaceship ke ‘farsh’ par waise hi force lagata hai jaise Zameen par.
Fig. 3.14 jaisi shakal ka spacecraft lein jis ka outer radius R hai aur jo apne central axis par angular speed ω se ghoomta hai. Rim par kisi point ka centripetal acceleration a꜀:

blocks.alt: Tirchha dekha gaya pahiye jaisa spaceship: chaurra hara outer kinara (rim) chaar spokes se beech ke hub se jura hai. Hub se guzarti dashed vertical (seedha khara) line rotation (ghoomna) ka axis hai, aur kinare ke gird laal mure teer pahiye ki rotation dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.14: Apne central axis ke gird ghoomta pahiye jaisa spaceship (kitab ki Figure 3.14 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Kitab yahan a꜀ ko “angular acceleration” kehti hai. a꜀ = Rω² rim ka centripetal acceleration hai; spaceship uniform (ek jaisi) ω se ghoom raha hai, is liye us ka angular acceleration zero hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Pahiye jaisa spaceship apne axis par ghoomta hai. Rim par khara astronaut daire mein chal raha hai; farsh us par centre ki taraf force lagata hai, aur yahi dhakka use “wazan” jaisa mehsoos hota hai.

blocks.text_alt: Lekin ω = 2π/t (t = ek chakkar ka waqt)

blocks.text: Ghoomte spaceship ki surface us cheez ko dhakelti hai jo us se chhoo rahi ho, aur yahi dhakka us cheez ko daire mein chalane wali centripetal force deta hai.
blocks.title: Do You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)

blocks.alt: Drum (dhol) jaisa space station tirchha dekha gaya, saamne se khula hua taake andar nazar aaye. Beech se ek axis guzarta hai, aur axis ke gird laal mura teer station ki rotation (ghoomna) dikhata hai. Andar spokes axis wale hub ko rim (kinare) se jorte hain, rim ki andar wali surface par saaman rakha hai, aur neela teer F꜀ rim se axis ki taraf hai.
blocks.caption: Do You Know? (PDF page 65): Ghoomta hua space station (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Hum chahte hain ke rim ka centripetal acceleration Zameen ki gravity ke barabar ho, is liye:
Jab spaceship is frequency se ghoome to us ke rehne walon ko Zameen jaisi artificial gravity milti hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Station apne axis par ghoomta hai. Rim ki andar wali surface us par rakhi cheez ko axis (centre) ki taraf dhakelti hai; yahi dhakka F꜀ centripetal force hai jo cheez ko daire mein chalata hai, aur andar rehne walon ko yahi “wazan” jaisa mehsoos hota hai.

blocks.caption: Satellite ke formulas
rows: g = v²/R; v = √(gR) ≈ 7.9 km s⁻¹; T = 2πR/v ≈ 85 min
Radius r ka koi bhi orbit
v = √(GM/r); satellite ka mass important nahi
mv²/r = mg − F_N aur g = v²/r se F_N = 0

blocks.prompt: Ek satellite Zameen ki surface se 200 km oonchai par ghoomta hai; Zameen ka radius 6400 km le kar us ki orbital speed nikalein. 20 m radius ka space station 0.5 rad s⁻¹ se ghoomta hai; astronauts kitni artificial gravity mehsoos karte hain? Astronaut weightlessness kyun mehsoos karta hai?
blocks.explanation: r = 6400 + 200 = 6600 km = 6.6 × 10⁶ m. v = √(GM/r) = √(6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ × 6.0 × 10²⁴ / 6.6 × 10⁶) ≈ 7.79 × 10³ m s⁻¹ ≈ 7.8 km s⁻¹. Space station: a꜀ = Rω² = 20 × (0.5)² = 5 m s⁻². Astronaut aur satellite dono ek hi acceleration g = v²/r se Zameen ki taraf freely gir rahe hain, is liye farsh ya spring ko sahara dene ki zaroorat nahi (F_N = 0): yahi apparent weightlessness hai.

items: Neecha orbit: g = v²/R, v = √(gR) ≈ 7.9 km s⁻¹ (critical velocity), T ≈ 85 min. Oonche orbit: kam speed, zyada period.
Orbital velocity v = √(GM/r): satellite ke mass par depend nahi karta. Example 3.4 (Chand jitna faasla): v ≈ 1.01 km s⁻¹, T ≈ 28 din.
Satellite mein F_N = 0: apparent weightlessness, kyunke sab kuch ek saath freely gir raha hai.
Artificial gravity: spaceship ko f = (1/2π)√(g/R) se ghumayein taake rim par a꜀ = Rω² = g ho.
